name: acp-gateway
description: Persistent local ACP gateway with Main-only control and worker-safe guidance.

scripts.test: sh -c 'export ACP_GATEWAY_DISABLE_DYNAMIC_PROVIDERS=1 ACP_GATEWAY_ARTIFACTS="$(mktemp -d)"; node --test test/*.test.js; s=$?; rm -rf "$ACP_GATEWAY_ARTIFACTS"; exit $s'
scripts.ci: node scripts/ci-check.js && node scripts/acp-upstream-monitor.js --validate && npm test
scripts.update:upstream: npm run monitor:update && npm run monitor:sync-dependencies && npm run ci
